changelog: Player: Fixed random app crashes caused by D-pad reaching unreachable Close button (controlCount 8→9)
Player: Firestick 30-min screen sleep permanently defeated — SCREEN_BRIGHT_WAKE_LOCK + FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON + FLAG_TURN_SCREEN_ON keeps display lit for entire playback session
Movies: Fixed category rail not filtering movies — Xtream Codes float category_id (12.0) now normalized to integer string (12) matching category list IDs
Movies: Firestick D-pad hover-select on category rail — movies update instantly as you navigate (Netflix/Prime-style), no OK press needed
Themes: Added 6 new intense neon UI themes — Neon Hot Pink, Neon Lamborghini Orange, Neon Smoke Grey, Neon Smoke White, Neon Charcoal Black, Neon Baby Blue
Settings: Subtitle outline color picker now wired — 8 color swatches (Black, Dark Navy, Dark Red, Dark Purple, Dark Green, Charcoal, White, Hot Pink)
Settings: Subtitle colors fully wired to LibVLC freetype renderer — size, color, outline color, and background opacity all apply on next stream open
DVR: Per-provider recording subfolders — recordings now organized as DVR/<server-hostname>/<filename>.ts for clean multi-account library management
notes: Steps: 1) Upload app-firestick-release.apk and app-premium-release.apk to Dropbox, get direct dl=1 links. 2) Run: Get-FileHash app-firestick-release.apk -Algorithm SHA256 and Get-FileHash app-premium-release.apk -Algorithm SHA256. 3) Fill in apkUrl, apkSize (bytes), sha256 for both flavors AND the top-level apkUrl/apkSize/sha256 (Firestick). 4) Save this file as update.json in gist 6056e65b41641393abf585cecbd92d07.
